svg.title: For the simple resonant cell this is the four-mode model with C(t) = g(t)H, where H = 2−1/2(︁1 1 1 −1 )︁. Uniform ready-subspace loss preserves the path state while transferring its excitation to retained lost modes. The full loss dynamics must be path blind; equal population decay rates alone do not exclude additional path dephasing. The bath and controller are retained. The physical + and −flags read ⟨±x| = 2−1/2(⟨0| ± ⟨1|) once the cell is off. Null, filter failure, source remainder and lost modes are inconclusive; no additional reader of them or of R is included.
